title: o-mcp/vocabulary version 1
description: The terms the plant tools use: node and edge classes and types, properties, utilities and quantities, each with its definition from the database. Returned by plant_vocabulary; a section left empty was not asked for. Unknown fields may appear in later version-1 documents; ignore them.

schema.description: Names the format. Check it, and version, before reading anything else.

version.description: Format version. Adding fields keeps it at 1; removing, renaming or changing the meaning of a field makes 2.

node_classes.description: The broad roles a node can have (graph.node_class).

code.description: Class code, such as BUS or LOAD.

node_types.description: Specific node types (graph.node_type), each in one class.

class.description: The node class every node of this type has.

parent.description: The type this one specialises, or null. A filter on the parent includes this type.

abstract.description: True for a type that only groups its subtypes and is never assigned to a node (SWITCHBOARD, WATER_TREATMENT).

description.description: What the type covers, how its nodes sit in the graph, and what may not be inferred from it.

properties.description: The properties a node of this type may carry, including those inherited from its parent types.

key.description: Property key, as it appears in a node's attrs.

requirement.description: REQUIRED (a named reader needs it; its absence is a PROPERTY_GAP finding) or OPTIONAL.

used_by.description: The report or program that needs it.

defined_on.description: The type the rule is set on: this type, or a parent it inherits from.

code.description: Class code: FEEDER, PIPE or COMPENSATION.

edge_types.description: Specific edge types (graph.edge_type) and which nodes each may join.

code.description: Edge type code, such as SUPPLY_LV or PV_INJECTION.

carries_flow.description: False for a connection that moves no energy (a capacitor bank on its board). Such edges stay out of flow totals.

is_transform.description: True when the edge changes voltage level (a transformer).

description.description: What the edge type means and where its meter, if any, is tapped.

endpoints.description: The allowed (from, to) pairs. Each end names a node type or a whole node class.

from.description: Node type or class the edge may start at.

from_is.description: Whether from names a node type or a node class.

to.description: Node type or class the edge may end at.

to_is.description: Whether to names a node type or a node class.

properties.description: Node properties (graph.property): what each attrs key holds and its allowed values.

key.description: The attrs key, such as main_breaker_a.

datatype.description: number, integer, text, date, enum or number[].

unit.description: Unit of the value, also in the key's suffix.

enum_values.description: The allowed values of an enum property.

kind.description: Where the value comes from: NAMEPLATE (read off the equipment), DESIGN, RECORD or SITE_STATUS.

description.description: What the property means, and which value is the rating where several could be.

base_unit.description: The unit its flows are totalled in.

quantities.description: The quantities meters report (graph.quantity_term), with the network model's rule where it resolves the quantity for every node.

code.description: Quantity code, as the readings and values tools take it.

quantity_id.description: The id telemetry stores it under.

unit.description: Unit; null for a dimensionless value such as power factor.

reading.description: COUNTER: a register that only grows; what matters is its difference over an interval. SAMPLE: a value at an instant.

description.description: What it measures, and how it is encoded where that matters.

rule.description: How the network model resolves it at every node, or null when it does not.

utility.description: The utility network it is solved over.

time_agg.description: How a meter's readings over a window become one number: DELTA (counter difference), AVG, P95 or SUM.

network_agg.description: How it reaches unmetered nodes: SUM (flow balance), INHERIT (from the feeder) or NONE (metered nodes only).

conserved.description: True for a flow that balances at every bus (energy, water, air).

derived_quantities.description: Quantities computed from two others at every node (graph.derived_quantity), such as PF_TRUE.

utility.description: The utility network it is computed over.

description.description: What it is, how it is computed, and when to prefer it.

from.description: The two quantity codes it is computed from.
